theme: Light Theme (Primary) with Saffron, White, and Deep Navy Accents. Emotion: Trustworthy, Authority, Optimistic, Culturally Rooted.

heading.instructions: Use tight letter-spacing for large headings. Use Google Fonts via CSS @import. Ensure line-height is tight (leading-none or leading-tight) for large headers.

body.instructions: Maintain high legibility. Use leading-relaxed for body text.

typography.pairing_archetype: The "Swiss Brutalist" (Tech / Art) modified for political authority. Clean sans-serif with varying weights for hierarchy.
typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl/6xl. Do not exceed 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading. Never use Inter for Headings.

colors.instructions: Tinted neutral greys with a slight warm (orange) undertone. Never use pure black (#000000), use slate or deep navy instead. Contrast ratio must be strictly followed.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp edges (border-slate-200/50). Nested radii: child <= parent.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid overly bright gradients. Use very subtle, sophisticated linear gradients (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-white to-slate-50).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper or noise texture to avoid digital flatness on Saffron backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Elegant Lotus motif (SVG) used as a watermark or subtle background decoration in premium sections (Donation, Leader Profiles).

component_rules.header: Sticky navigation, bilingual toggle (EN/HI). Glassmorphism effect: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200. Mobile-first hamburger menu. Subtle saffron accent line at bottom.
component_rules.hero_carousel: Full-width, auto-slide, swipeable. Text overlay max opacity bg-black/40. Indicators and Prev/Next buttons with premium hover states.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle rounded-md for primary actions. Saffron background with white text for CTA. Always include interactive hover/focus states.
component_rules.cards: Premium cards for Leadership and News. Soft shadows, subtle borders, elegant translateY(-4px) on hover.
component_rules.donation_section: Premium Saffron background (#FF9933) with dark text or White text depending on contrast. Elegant lotus motif watermark. ₹10,001 minimum validation logic.
component_rules.footer: Deep Navy Blue background with white text. Tricolor strip (Saffron, White, Green) at the absolute bottom edge.

grids.leadership: Bento-style or balanced grid. 1 column on mobile, 3-4 columns on desktop. gap-6 or gap-8.
grids.news_events: Asymmetrical or mixed grid to create visual interest. E.g., one featured news item (col-span-2) and smaller cards (col-span-1).

layouts.mobile_first: Ensure no horizontal scroll, touch-friendly tap targets (min 44px), swipeable carousels.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-16 to py-24 for main sections. p-6 or p-8 for inner card padding.
layouts.alternating_layout: About section uses alternating image/text blocks (Image Left/Text Right, then Text Left/Image Right) on desktop.

motion.interactions: Hover states (transform, shadow, color shift). Click/press scale (scale-95).
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up entrances for lists/cards using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Saffron meets 4.5:1 (use deep navy or dark slate text on saffron if white fails, or darken saffron slightly).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='donate-button').

media.images: Images capped at 80vh height on mobile. Use object-cover for hero banners.
media.icons: Use lucide-react for UI icons. Do not use emoji icons.
media.galleries: Media gallery with tabs (Live, Videos, Photos) and full-screen viewer.

3d_libraries.map: Use 'react-simple-maps' for the 'Our Footprints' interactive India map. Allow state selection, hover effects (Saffron hover), and side panel statistics.

hero_banners.description: Crowd holding a banner, suitable for rally/political hero banner (use with dark overlay).
Parliament building for official, patriotic hero banner.

motifs_and_backgrounds.description: Pink lotus flower macro, can be used as a soft background or feature image.

news_events.description: Large gathering, good for event thumbnails.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the app using React + Tailwind + Shadcn UI.
Include both a public marketing site (Home, About, News, Events, Donate) and an admin dashboard.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>, use Shadcn UI components.
Implement language toggling logic (Hindi/English) visually and contextually across the site.
Ensure 'Our Footprints' map is interactive. You can use an SVG map of India or react-simple-maps.
Donation form MUST have a ₹10,001 minimum validation logic.
Keep the codebase clean, modular, and use direct children for grids.
Use 'Outfit' for English headings, 'Yantramanav' for Hindi headings. Apply via CSS.
Ensure 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
The main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or services like via.placeholder.com.
